historical_run_startup.scope: From the loading-managed-splits log to the fitting-V10-statistics log; includes input validation and model construction, not framework environment/staging or an epoch.

atomic_context_decode_microbenchmark.scope: One existing protein, five warm-file repetitions with alternating order. Decode arrays only, not source parsing, context reconstruction, normalization or training.
atomic_context_decode_microbenchmark.unchanged_checks: Whole-base SHA-256, context field reconstruction, source correspondence, dtype/shape/mask/numerical checks.
atomic_context_decode_microbenchmark.limitation: This is not an end-to-end speedup measurement. Validation is still performed once per selected member in each Run; surface evaluation now reuses the same validated input bindings. No training or cluster job was launched.
